extra_move.name: Extra Move
extra_move.description: One use. Gives +1 move this turn in battle.

barricade.name: Barricade
barricade.description: One use. Drop a wall on an empty tile to block enemy movement and line of sight.

flare.name: Flare
flare.description: One use. Clears the snow in a 3x3 area around a tile of your choice.

snowshoes.name: Snowshoes
snowshoes.description: One use. This turn, snow melts on every tile you step onto as you move.

smoke_screen.name: Smoke Screen
smoke_screen.description: One use. Hides one of your pieces from enemy targeting until it moves or attacks.

quick_step.name: Quick Step
quick_step.description: One use. Removes the frozen status from one piece and lets it move normally this turn.

warm_cloak.name: Warm Cloak
warm_cloak.description: One use. Protects one piece from ever being frozen by snow for the rest of the battle.

salt_the_earth.name: Salt the Earth
salt_the_earth.description: One use. Salt a tile - it can never be covered by fog again for the rest of the battle.

night_watch.name: Night Watch
night_watch.description: One use. Reveals one chosen enemy piece through fog for the rest of the battle.

decoy.name: Decoy
decoy.description: One use. Place a fake piece on an empty tile - the enemy AI always targets it first, but losing it doesn't count as a real casualty.

warhorn.name: Warhorn
warhorn.description: One use. Reveals every move the enemy could make this turn.

bastion.name: Bastion
bastion.description: One use. Drop two walls on empty tiles to block enemy movement and line of sight.

signal_fire.name: Signal Fire
signal_fire.description: One use. Briefly pulses the location of every piece on the board, yours and the enemy's, even through fog.

bonfire_flare.name: Bonfire Flare
bonfire_flare.description: One use. Clears the snow in a 5x5 area around a tile of your choice.

camp_kit.name: Camp Kit
camp_kit.description: One use. Removes the frozen status from every allied piece at once.

frozen_lure.name: Frozen Lure
frozen_lure.description: One use. Place bait on an empty tile - the first enemy to step on it is frozen for a turn.

mirror_ward.name: Mirror Ward
mirror_ward.description: One use. The next capture attempt against a chosen piece is completely cancelled.

avalanche_horn.name: Avalanche Horn
avalanche_horn.description: One use. Pushes every enemy in a 3x3 area back one tile.

wildfire_flare.name: Wildfire Flare
wildfire_flare.description: One use. Clears the snow in a 3x3 area around a tile of your choice; the tiles just outside that area turn to thin, half-melted fog that finishes clearing on its own next turn.

permafrost_flare.name: Permafrost Flare
permafrost_flare.description: One use. Freezes a 3x3 area for one turn - enemies cannot enter it.

rampart.name: Rampart
rampart.description: One use. Drop three walls on empty tiles to block enemy movement and line of sight.

storm_horn.name: Storm Horn
storm_horn.description: One use. Reveals every move the enemy could make, for the next 2 enemy turns.

howling_gale.name: Howling Gale
howling_gale.description: One use. Clears all snow from one full row.

hunters_snare.name: Hunter's Snare
hunters_snare.description: One use. Place a trap on an empty tile - the first enemy to step on it is frozen and revealed for the rest of the battle.

frost_nova.name: Frost Nova
frost_nova.description: One use. Freezes every enemy adjacent to a chosen tile for one turn.

blink_step.name: Blink Step
blink_step.description: One use. While an ally is selected, drag onto another ally to instantly swap their positions, ignoring normal movement rules.

avalanche.name: Avalanche
avalanche.description: One use. Pushes every enemy on the board back 3 tiles; any pushed into a wall or obstacle are frozen instead.

stormcaller.name: Stormcaller
stormcaller.description: One use. Clears the snow in a 3x3 area around a tile of your choice and freezes any enemy standing in it.

seers_horn.name: Seer's Horn
seers_horn.description: One use. Reveals one chosen enemy's actual planned move for the turn.

blizzard_ender.name: Blizzard Ender
blizzard_ender.description: One use. Clears the snow across the entire battlefield.

aurora_flare.name: Aurora Flare
aurora_flare.description: One use. Clears all snow on the current floor.

spyglass.name: Spyglass
spyglass.description: When selecting a piece, tiles the enemy could capture next turn are marked.

bloodhounds.name: Bloodhounds
bloodhounds.description: A friendly wolf joins each battle and hunts on its own after your turn.

vicious_knights.name: Vicious Knights
vicious_knights.description: Once per turn, a knight that captures may move again.

bounty.name: Bounty
bounty.description: Each battle a random enemy is marked. If it is the first enemy to fall, gain upgrade items.

footprints.name: Footprints
footprints.description: Tiles your pieces have walked on can never be covered by fog again for the rest of the battle.

tracker.name: Tracker
tracker.description: A spotted enemy's last move stays marked on the board until it moves again.

loyal_pawns.name: Loyal Pawns
loyal_pawns.description: Once per battle, a capture aimed at a piece next to a friendly pawn lands on the pawn instead.

castle.name: Castle
castle.description: Your king cannot be captured while a friendly rook has line of sight to him.

keen_eye.name: Keen Eye
keen_eye.description: Bishops reveal fog along their diagonal path as they move.

knight_errant.name: Knight Errant
knight_errant.description: Once per turn, a knight that captures and lands next to another enemy may move again.

nightfall_ward.name: Nightfall Ward
nightfall_ward.description: The first time an ally would be frozen by snow each battle, it isn't.

salvage.name: Salvage
salvage.description: Captured enemy pieces have a chance to drop an extra upgrade item.

courier_package.name: Courier Package
courier_package.description: Each battle a random ally is the courier. If they survive the battle, gain upgrade items.

divine_intervention.name: Divine Intervention
divine_intervention.description: Consumed on party wipe: return to the map instead of game over.

iron_pawns.name: Iron Pawns
iron_pawns.description: Pawns cannot be captured on a turn where they move exactly 1 tile.

watchtower.name: Watchtower
watchtower.description: Rooks reveal any enemy piece along their rank or file, even through fog.

farsight_lens.name: Farsight Lens
farsight_lens.description: When selecting any piece, tiles the enemy could capture next turn are marked for your entire party.

old_guard.name: Old Guard
old_guard.description: Each battle a random ally is the sentry. If they are never captured, gain upgrade items.

fortress.name: Fortress
fortress.description: Enemies cannot cross the line between a friendly rook and a house in its line of sight.

mounted_hunters.name: Mounted Hunters
mounted_hunters.description: Your queen and bishops may also move like knights.

foresight_mirror.name: Foresight Mirror
foresight_mirror.description: Threat tiles are shown 2 enemy turns ahead instead of 1.

twin_strike.name: Twin Strike
twin_strike.description: Once per battle, a piece that captures and lands next to another enemy may capture again.

war_council.name: War Council
war_council.description: Before your turn, the order enemies will act in is shown on the board.

iron_resolve.name: Iron Resolve
iron_resolve.description: Once per battle, a piece that would be captured while adjacent to your king instead survives and is pushed to the nearest empty tile.

steel_vanguard.name: Steel Vanguard
steel_vanguard.description: Pawns cannot be captured at all while adjacent to another friendly pawn.

frostguard_talisman.name: Frostguard Talisman
frostguard_talisman.description: The first two times an ally would be frozen by snow each battle, they aren't.

queens_gambit.name: Queen's Gambit
queens_gambit.description: Once per battle, your queen may capture through blocking pieces - after her next capture, she freezes and can't act next turn.

frozen_vanguard.name: Frozen Vanguard
frozen_vanguard.description: The first friendly piece captured each battle is frozen in place instead, and cannot be captured again for the rest of that turn.

spectral_queen.name: Spectral Queen
spectral_queen.description: Your queen cannot be captured during the first 2 turns of each battle.

royal_guard.name: Royal Guard
royal_guard.description: Once per battle, if your king would be captured, an adjacent friendly piece is captured in its place instead.

lucky_charm.name: Lucky Charm
lucky_charm.description: Treasure chests are more likely to hold rarer items, and sometimes hold an extra one.

drillmaster.name: Drillmaster
drillmaster.description: Once per battle, drag onto an ally while another ally is selected to swap their positions.

prospectors_pick.name: Prospector's Pick
prospectors_pick.description: Each battle a random enemy is marked. If it is the first enemy to fall, gain upgrade items.

fortunes_favor.name: Fortune's Favor
fortunes_favor.description: Treasure chests are noticeably more likely to hold rarer items, and sometimes hold an extra one.

hoarders_ring.name: Hoarder's Ring
hoarders_ring.description: Selling items grants double sell value for the rest of the run.

frostbite_ward.name: Frostbite Ward
frostbite_ward.description: A shard of the Winter March, cold to the touch.

ravens_eye.name: Raven's Eye
ravens_eye.description: Tiles you've cleared of snow can never be covered by snowfall/blizzard fog again for the rest of the battle.

frozen_rampart.name: Frozen Rampart
frozen_rampart.description: Once per battle, drop a wall on an empty tile to block enemy movement and line of sight, without spending an item.

golden_quarry.name: Golden Quarry
golden_quarry.description: Each battle two random enemies are marked. If either is the first to fall, gain upgrade items.

fate_weaver.name: Fate Weaver
fate_weaver.description: Treasure chests are much more likely to hold rarer items, sometimes hold an extra one, and always contain at least one artifact-tier item.

vanguards_oath.name: Vanguard's Oath
vanguards_oath.description: Each battle, the first ally to threaten an enemy gains a free extra move on your following turn.

winter_kings_crown.name: Winter King's Crown
winter_kings_crown.description: A relic of a forgotten king, said to protect its wearer.

crown_of_the_long_night.name: Crown of the Long Night
crown_of_the_long_night.description: Surviving a party wipe with Divine Intervention also grants 3 upgrade items.

oracle_glass.name: Oracle Glass
oracle_glass.description: Reveals the enemy's actual planned move for the turn, not just the tiles they threaten.
